# Version 4.151.0
> **Managed performance improvements** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 bumps to Skia m151 and ports several hot-path conversions to managed C# for better performance. Color, premultiply, and HarfBuzz text-shaping paths gain allocation-free, zero-copy implementations, alongside upstream Chrome M151 bug fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia bumped to milestone 151** — SkiaSharp now tracks Skia m151, including several rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes merged along the way. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed a native resource leak decoding images** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks a native resource on each call. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Color and premultiply conversions moved to managed code** — SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer math instead of round-tripping through native calls, and SKColor hex parsing gained ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **HarfBuzzSharp text shaping reduced allocations** — Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now uses a pooled allocation-free UTF-8 encode, Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse no longer allocate a char[4] per call, and SKShaper glyph results are read via zero-copy spans. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 reduces UTF-8 buffer and tag-parsing allocations and reads shaper glyph results via zero-copy spans.
